module_summary: Asynchronous FIFO: binary write/read pointers converted to Gray code, cross-synchronized by two-flop synchronizers to derive full/empty, with a dual-port RAM child for storage.

anchors.name: waddr_bin
anchors.why: Binary write pointer in wclk domain, increments on winc when not full; low bits address RAM.

anchors.name: raddr_bin
anchors.why: Binary read pointer in rclk domain, increments on rinc when not empty; low bits address RAM.

anchors.name: wptr
anchors.why: Registered Gray-coded write pointer sent to read domain and compared for full.

anchors.name: rptr
anchors.why: Registered Gray-coded read pointer sent to write domain and compared for empty.

anchors.name: rptr_syn
anchors.why: Second stage of read-pointer synchronizer into wclk domain; used for full detection.

anchors.name: wptr_syn
anchors.why: Second stage of write-pointer synchronizer into rclk domain; used for empty detection.

anchors.name: winc
anchors.why: Write request; advances write pointer and enables RAM write when not full.

anchors.name: rinc
anchors.why: Read request; advances read pointer and enables RAM read when not empty.

anchors.name: wdata
anchors.why: Write data payload passed into dual-port RAM.

anchors.name: rdata
anchors.why: Read data output from dual-port RAM.

anchors.name: wfull
anchors.why: Full flag from Gray compare with synchronized read pointer; blocks writes.

anchors.name: rempty
anchors.why: Empty flag from Gray compare with synchronized write pointer; blocks reads.

anchors.name: wen
anchors.why: RAM write enable: winc qualified by not full.

anchors.name: ren
anchors.why: RAM read enable: rinc qualified by not empty.

groups.name: write_controller
groups.description: Write-domain binary pointer, Gray conversion, write enable and RAM write address.

groups.name: read_controller
groups.description: Read-domain binary pointer, Gray conversion, read enable and RAM read address.

groups.name: pointer_synchronizers
groups.description: Two-flop synchronizers crossing Gray pointers between wclk and rclk domains.

groups.name: full_empty_logic
groups.description: Gray-code comparisons producing wfull and rempty flags.

groups.name: storage
groups.description: Dual-port RAM child storing FIFO data, written on wclk and read on rclk.
